purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery records. These are verified source leads, dataset records, map/media records, or publisher/archive records, not extracted cultural claims and not proof of unrestricted redistribution or commercial reuse.

records.title: Hindi to Mundari Translation Dataset Corpus
records.publisher: Karya / Microsoft Research India / Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur
records.author: Karya dataset collaboration
records.notes: The project repository documents a UTF-8 Hindi-to-Mundari parallel corpus containing 17,826 sentence pairs in translation-hi-unr.tsv. Register as a modern language-technology dataset lead only; sentence-level provenance, contributor conditions and culturally sensitive content must be reviewed before any MLHKP ingestion or public evidence use.
records.rights_note: Repository states Karya Public License BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0: noncommercial use only, attribution required, share-alike applies, and software-incorporation conditions include GPL obligations. No commercial-reuse entitlement is inferred.

records.title: Expressives and the multimodal depiction of social types in Mundari
records.publisher: Language in Society / Cambridge University Press
records.author: Nishaant Choksi
records.notes: Publisher metadata verifies the article and its use of video interview data with Mundari speakers to analyse expressives and social-indexical meaning. Register as a peer-reviewed source lead. Interview-derived descriptions and linguistic analyses remain source-reported scholarship and require passage-level evidence plus any applicable participant/data-access review before MLHKP factual use.
records.rights_note: Publisher-page visibility does not establish permission to redistribute the article, embedded examples, interview video, transcripts, figures or supplementary data.

records.title: Munda languages map.svg
records.author: C1MM (uploaded as own work based on Noahedits; derivative of Dravidian map.svg)
records.notes: Wikimedia Commons metadata identifies an SVG map dated 28 November 2020 depicting areas with significant concentrations of Munda-language speakers and a North/South Munda classification. Register as a map/media lead only. Geographic assertions require validation against the map's underlying data and authoritative census/geospatial sources before use as MLHKP evidence.
records.rights_note: The file page states CC BY-SA 3.0. Attribution and share-alike requirements must be preserved, and the licence does not make the map's underlying geographic assertions independently authoritative.

records.title: How to play hockey, written in 'Mundari': The story of a Jharkhand Bishop and a forgotten rule book
records.author: Soumi Das
records.notes: Indian Express feature dated 18 October 2023 reports on a rare surviving copy of a Mundari field-hockey rule book associated with Sadanand Abinash Bishram Dilbar Hans and identifies family-held provenance for the surviving copy. Register as a media-led historical source locator, not as verification of the book's contents. The primary rule book requires independent bibliographic identification, owner permission and page-level evidence before ingestion.
records.rights_note: News access does not establish reproduction rights for the article, photographs or privately held rule book. Primary-object access, digitization and reuse require separate permission and provenance review.

records.title: Simdega Heritage Centre museum report with Mundari oral-history material
records.author: Manas Srivastava
records.notes: Indian Express report on the Simdega Heritage Centre describes a museum presentation that juxtaposes colonial archival records with community oral-history material, including a Mundari song associated with First World War labour migration memory. Register as a museum/media discovery lead only. The underlying archival records, song, performers/community custodianship, transcription and museum documentation require separate source records and cultural-access review before evidence ingestion.
records.rights_note: Article access does not grant rights to reproduce museum displays, archival documents, song text/audio, photographs or community-held oral-history material. Item-level rights, consent and cultural access remain controlling.
